test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"caused."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Caused"** is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1. • This is because it fits the context of the sentence and is grammatically correct. • **"Caused"** means to make something happen. (कुछ होने का कारण बनना, उत्‍पन्‍न करना) • **Example**: *The fire was **caused**__ by an electrical fault.* • The correct answer is Option 3. • **Correct passage**: Isolation and loneliness __**caused**__ by the Covid-19 pandemic and lockdown policies negatively ______ (2) ______ the mental health of the public throughout the entire globe. These result in an increase in emotional ______ (3) ______, ______ (4) ______ of hopelessness and extreme anxiety, which are ______ (5) ______ by variations in emotional responses and style of living. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Built: **to make something by putting pieces, materials, etc. together. (बनाना, निर्माण करना) • **Constructed: **to build or make something. (किसी वस्‍तु का निर्माण करना, बनाना; रचना) • **Prepared: **to get ready or to make somebody/something ready. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का तैयार होना या उसे तैयार करना) 1e4:Tce9, The correct answer is **"impacted."**
